title: Agent writes a TODO comment instead of diagnosing and fixing a discoverable issue
summary: The agent encounters a fixable defect or inconsistency in a touched surface and drops a TODO comment instead of investigating the root cause and landing the fix.
currentFailure: The agent treats a TODO comment as bug closure, skipping diagnosis and skipping the actual fix. The TODO records the problem, but it does not remove it.

surfaceChecks.description: The skill rejects TODOs as closure for discovered bugs.
patterns: TODO comments, issue links, and doc notes may accompany the record
Treating a TODO, issue, or plan as closure for a discovered bug
A TODO comment is not bug closure

surfaceChecks.description: The rationalization table explicitly rejects TODO-as-closure framing.
patterns: I will just add a TODO
A TODO comment is not bug closure

surfaceChecks.description: Always-on routing sends TODO/FIXME discoveries through campsite triage.

samples.noncompliant: I noticed a bug in the error handling path while editing this file. I'm just adding a TODO for now so someone can look at it later. Leaving a TODO for now should be enough since the main task is done.
samples.compliant: I discovered a bug in the error handling path in the file I am already editing. Per campsite-rule, this is a local issue in my touched surface, so I need to diagnose the root cause and fix it now. I will investigate the defect, land the fix, and add a regression test to prevent recurrence.
